title: Contoso Climate Solutions Equity — Q1 2026 review
content: Q1 saw a -1.5% YTD return as policy uncertainty pressured renewable equipment names. ESG composite remains 9.1 — top decile across the Foundry IQ peer group. Sector breakdown: renewables 41%, industrials (energy efficiency) 28%, utilities 22%, other 9%. Fund has rotated into US storage and grid-modernisation names following the late-Q1 IRA-extension headlines. Key risk: short-cycle policy reversal in the EU CBAM phase-in. Suitable for clients with a multi-year ESG mandate and tolerance for thematic drawdowns.
